text:
Mia: Hey team — customer (org_id: org_9X2b) says their Token Cost dashboard shows $0 and some rows as NaN since ~2026-02-28. Screenshot attached: https://redwood.internal/snap/abc123. Can someone triage?

Raj: Thanks, pinging analytics + billing. Which orgs affected? is it all orgs or a subset?

Mia: Only a handful. I pulled a quick list: org_9X2b, org_4H7k, org_0Qp4. Appears for any query with date >= 2026-02-28. Older dates OK.

Kevin: I see an ingestion job failure logged 2026-02-28 03:14 UTC on metrics-ingest-v2 around the same time. Error: "TypeError: cannot convert NoneType to float" for column "token_cost_usd". That would produce NaN downstream.

ingest-bot: metrics-ingest-v2 job failed (run 2026-02-28T03:14:12Z). Error: schema mismatch on /s3/metrics/2026/02/28/part-03.parquet

Raj: Probable pipeline root cause. Kevin, please confirm whether retries fixed some files later (why some orgs fine).

Kevin: Looking — pipeline retried at 03:17 and 03:23. The file for org_9X2b never reprocessed due to missing org_id metadata in the manifest; a fallback path wrote a null token_cost_usd and the analytics join didn't coalesce. Query we use: ```SELECT org_id, date, SUM(token_cost_usd) as cost FROM token_metrics WHERE date >= '2026-02-28' GROUP BY 1,2;``` If token_cost_usd is null, front-end chart shows NaN or 0 depending on aggregation.

Alisa: From billing side: we received usage batches ok. Billing connector processed raw usage, but currency conversion step flagged rows with nulls and logged conversion error. Connector left them as null rather than 0. That explains NaN on dashboard.

Jordan: Customer on the thread says this is blocking finance recon for Feb. They want an ETA and temporary workaround.

Mia: I told them we'll update in 30m. Can we produce a quick mitigation: re-run ingest for the affected partitions and force null->0 coalesce?

Kevin: I'll re-run the ingestion for the affected S3 prefixes and set a transform to coalesce(token_cost_usd, 0.0) for the materialized table. Doing a dry-run first.

Raj: Heads-up: if we coalesce to 0 unconditionally, we might hide real missing data. Prefer to repair source files where possible, then fallback to coalesce only in the UI for a short window.

Alisa: Agreed. Billing can provide original usage payloads for org_9X2b and org_4H7k to repopulate token_cost_usd. I'll push those to the staging bucket now (s3://redwood-staging/billing-replay/2026-02-28/).

Kevin: Dry-run re-ingest succeeded for org_4H7k and org_0Qp4; manifest was missing org_id for org_9X2b — looks like an upstream producer bug. Replayed staging files for 4H7k/0Qp4; dashboard values updated to show expected costs.

Mia: Nice. Customer confirmed org_4H7k now shows numbers. They still see NaN for org_9X2b.

Kevin: For org_9X2b I can do a temporary UI-level coalesce so the chart renders 0 instead of NaN while we fix source. That should unblock finance. Will add a comment in the dashboard and set a 72h TTL on the fallback.

Raj: Also open a bug to producer team: missing org_id metadata in metrics manifests. Tag: ENG-emit-metadata-missing. Contributor: @producer-service.

Alisa: I've uploaded the original payloads for org_9X2b; Kevin, once you have a repaired pipeline that picks them up we can reconcile billing totals.

Kevin: Reingest job kicked off for org_9X2b 2026-02-28 partitions. ETA ~12m. I'll post logs here and the query to validate.

ingest-bot: reingest job started (run: replay-2026-02-28-org_9X2b)

Kevin: LOG: replay-2026-02-28-org_9X2b completed 2026-02-28T04:05Z, rows repaired: 2,345. After materialization, running validation query: ```SELECT org_id, date, SUM(coalesce(token_cost_usd,0)) as cost FROM token_metrics WHERE org_id='org_9X2b' AND date >= '2026-02-28' GROUP BY 1,2;``` Numbers now match billing.

Mia: Customer confirms all three orgs now show correct costs. They're happy. Jordan, please follow up on the finance reconciliation items.

Jordan: Will do. I'll schedule a 1:1 with finance and the customer. Also adding a KB article: "Token Cost Dashboard NaN/0 after ingestion failures" with repro and mitigation steps.

Raj: Postmortem action items: (1) producer - ensure org_id in manifest (ENG-emit-metadata-missing) (2) pipeline - validate schema and fail fast with alerting (3) UI - render explicit "data unavailable" instead of NaN with link to incident.

Mia: Thanks all. I'll close the ticket after Jordan confirms finance ok. :white_check_mark:
